description: Create a new Radix Wiki page. Requires a ROLA bearer token; see https://radix.wiki/AGENTS.md for the challenge-sign-verify flow. Call get_categories first for a valid tagPath. Needs a wallet holding at least 10,000 $XRD (ecosystem 20,000, blog 50,000, ideas 10,000), a balance check that spends nothing. Earns contribution points.

content.description: Array of typed blocks. Start with an infobox, hyperlink every assertion to its source, no inline styles.

items.description: A typed block with a unique `id` (UUID) and a `type`. A `content` block carries semantic HTML in `text`; an `infobox` carries nested `blocks`. For any other type, copy the shape of one already on a page: get_page with `blocks: true` (or GET /api/wiki/{path}) returns blocks as stored.

pages.description: Page ids in display order (list, `chosen`): the `id` get_page returns with `blocks: true`

show.description: Each page as a link with its age, or as a card with its banner and opening line (list)

source.description: Where a list's pages come from (list): `under` the pages in the category `under` names, `newest` the newest `count` pages (within `under` if given), `chosen` the pages in `pages`

metadata.description: Key-value metadata for the page, including `excerpt` (one sentence, ≤160 chars). Some tag paths require specific keys — the error names any that are missing.

slug.description: URL slug (derived from the title when omitted)

tagPath.description: Tag path the page lives under (e.g. "contents/tech/core-concepts")

name: create_page
title: Create a page
